metric: number of contracts owning N storage slots, by bucket
source: mainnet from state-benchmarks #5 (block 24,927,663); 5× from #29 (block 24,546,596). Exact slotCountHistogram from the sidecar full scan.
note: ~87% of contracts own just 1–3 slots, while a tail of ~4,000 contracts hold 16k+ slots each — and that tail dominates total storage bytes. The 5× state preserves this mainnet long-tail shape (it was rebloated to match composition), which is exactly the property a faithful synthetic state must keep.
